column_semantics: The schedule has separate columns for Reference Rate and Spread (b) and Interest Rate (b). For PIK loans, the Reference Rate and Spread column prints the cash spread with the PIK component appended parenthetically, e.g. SOFR + 7.00% (0.50% PIK). The Interest Rate column prints the current cash leg rate excluding the parenthetical PIK amount; PIK is additive/on top, not included in that stated interest rate.

rationale: The filing does not use a single all-in coupon column for PIK loans. Instead, each PIK row places the PIK percentage in parentheses after the spread in the Reference Rate and Spread column while the adjacent Interest Rate column remains the current cash rate. Large PIK examples make this especially clear: Personal Care prints SOFR + 10.00% (10.00% PIK) with Interest Rate 13.67%, and CCI Prime prints SOFR + 7.25% (5.50% PIK) with Interest Rate 10.95%; those Interest Rate values are not all-in coupons including the PIK component.
